channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: New analysis warns Trump offshore drilling plan could trigger thousands of oil spills
item.description: Conservationists say increased drilling could threaten already endangered marine species with extinction.

item.title: DHS warehouse jail plan signals historic expansion of immigration detention
item.description: Documents and reporting reveal a sweeping plan to convert warehouses and deploy military contracting to rapidly expand immigration jails across the United States.

item.title: The digital media oligarchy: Who owns online news?
item.description: Even Bagdikian’s later editions, written at the dawn of the internet, could not fully anticipate how profoundly digital technology would reconfigure the media oligarchy.

item.title: Judge blocks Noem effort to bar surprise ICE jail inspections as detention deaths mount
item.description: A federal judge halted the DHS secretary’s renewed effort to block surprise inspections as deaths, overcrowding, and abuse allegations inside immigration detention facilities continue to rise.
